proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {i, j, k} := by decide +revert
  have hci : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → ({l}ᶜ : Set (Fin 3)) = {m, n} := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff]
    revert x l m n
    decide
  have gram : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → (dist (t.points m) (t.points n) * t.height l) ^ 2 =
      dist (t.points l) (t.points m) ^ 2 * dist (t.points m) (t.points n) ^ 2 -
        ((dist (t.points l) (t.points m) ^ 2 + dist (t.points m) (t.points n) ^ 2 - dist (t.points l) (t.points n) ^ 2) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn
    have hD := t.altitudeFoot_mem_affineSpan_image_compl l
    rw [hci l m n hlm hln hmn, Set.image_pair] at hD
    have h1 := t.inner_vsub_altitudeFoot_vsub_altitudeFoot_eq_zero hlm
    have h2 := t.inner_vsub_altitudeFoot_vsub_altitudeFoot_eq_zero hln
    have hh : t.height l = ‖t.points l -ᵥ t.altitudeFoot l‖ := by rw [Affine.Simplex.height, dist_eq_norm_vsub V]
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hD
    simp only at h1 h2
    rw [hh]
    rw [← hr] at h1 h2 ⊢
    have e1 : t.points m -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points m) (t.points n) r = (-r) • (t.points n -ᵥ t.points m) := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vsub_self, zero_sub, neg_smul]
    have e2 : t.points n -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points m) (t.points n) r = (1 - r) • (t.points n -ᵥ t.points m) := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
    set q := t.points l -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points m) (t.points n) r with hq
    have d1 : dist (t.points l) (t.points m) ^ 2 = ‖q‖ ^ 2 + r ^ 2 * ‖t.points n -ᵥ t.points m‖ ^ 2 := by
      have e : t.points l -ᵥ t.points m = q - (t.points m -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points m) (t.points n) r) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
      rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V, e, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_comm, h1, e1, norm_smul, mul_pow]
      simp
    have d2 : dist (t.points l) (t.points n) ^ 2 = ‖q‖ ^ 2 + (1 - r) ^ 2 * ‖t.points n -ᵥ t.points m‖ ^ 2 := by
      have e : t.points l -ᵥ t.points n = q - (t.points n -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points m) (t.points n) r) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
      rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V, e, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_comm, h2, e2, norm_smul, mul_pow]
      simp
    have d3 : dist (t.points m) (t.points n) = ‖t.points n -ᵥ t.points m‖ := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V]
    rw [d1, d2, d3]
    ring
  have comm : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → dist (t.points m) (t.points n) * t.height l = dist (t.points n) (t.points l) * t.height m := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn
    have hl := t.height_pos l
    have hm := t.height_pos m
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), gram l m n hlm hln hmn, gram m n l hmn hlm.symm hln.symm,
      dist_comm (t.points m) (t.points l), dist_comm (t.points n) (t.points l)]
    ring
  have hi := t.height_pos i
  have hj := t.height_pos j
  have hk := t.height_pos k
  set a := dist (t.points j) (t.points k) with ha
  have c1 := comm i j k hij hik hjk
  have c2 := comm j k i hjk hij.symm hik.symm
  have hSum : ∑ m, t.excenterWeightsUnnorm ∅ m = (t.height i)⁻¹ + (t.height j)⁻¹ + (t.height k)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hu, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]), Finset.sum_singleton]
    simp [Affine.Simplex.excenterWeightsUnnorm, add_assoc]
  have hsum := t.sum_excenterWeights_eq_one_iff.2 t.excenterExists_empty
  have hz := Finset.sum_smul_vsub_const_eq_affineCombination_vsub (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) (t.excenterWeights ∅) t.points t.incenter hsum
  rw [← t.incenter_eq_affineCombination, vsub_self, hu, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]), Finset.sum_singleton] at hz
  have hw : ∀ l, t.excenterWeights ∅ l = (∑ m, t.excenterWeightsUnnorm ∅ m)⁻¹ * (t.height l)⁻¹ := by
    intro l
    simp [Affine.Simplex.excenterWeights, Affine.Simplex.excenterWeightsUnnorm]
  rw [hw, hw, hw, hSum] at hz
  have hS : 0 < (t.height i)⁻¹ + (t.height j)⁻¹ + (t.height k)⁻¹ := by positivity
  set S := (t.height i)⁻¹ + (t.height j)⁻¹ + (t.height k)⁻¹ with hSdef
  have e1 : a = (S * (a * t.height i)) * (S⁻¹ * (t.height i)⁻¹) := by field_simp
  have e2 : dist (t.points k) (t.points i) = (S * (a * t.height i)) * (S⁻¹ * (t.height j)⁻¹) := by rw [c1]; field_simp
  have e3 : dist (t.points i) (t.points j) = (S * (a * t.height i)) * (S⁻¹ * (t.height k)⁻¹) := by rw [c1, c2]; field_simp
  have : a • (t.points i -ᵥ t.incenter) + dist (t.points k) (t.points i) • (t.points j -ᵥ t.incenter) + dist (t.points i) (t.points j) • (t.points k -ᵥ t.incenter) =
      (S * (a * t.height i)) • ((S⁻¹ * (t.height i)⁻¹) • (t.points i -ᵥ t.incenter) + ((S⁻¹ * (t.height j)⁻¹) • (t.points j -ᵥ t.incenter) + (S⁻¹ * (t.height k)⁻¹) • (t.points k -ᵥ t.incenter))) := by
    rw [smul_add, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← e1, ← e2, ← e3, add_assoc]
  rw [this, hz, smul_zero]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → dist (t.points j) (t.points k) • (t.points i -ᵥ t.incenter) + dist (t.points k) (t.points i) • (t.points j -ᵥ t.incenter) + dist (t.points i) (t.points j) • (t.points k -ᵥ t.incenter) = (0 : V)
